## Functional Specification

Domain: emulator
Summary: A complete CHIP-8 interpreter that accurately emulates the 1970s virtual machine with all 35 opcodes, timers, and I/O

### Requirements (MUST implement)
- Must execute all 35 CHIP-8 opcodes with cycle-accurate behavior
- Must implement 60Hz delay timer and sound timer
- Must support 64x32 monochrome display with sprite drawing
- Must handle 16-key hexadecimal keypad input
- Must load ROM files up to 3584 bytes (0xE00-0xFFF)
- Must implement big-endian 16-bit instruction fetch
- Must handle sprite collision detection for XOR drawing
- Must generate sound buzzer when sound timer > 0

### Data Structures
- 16 8-bit registers V0-VF where VF is carry flag
- 16-bit index register I (0x000-0xFFF)
- 16-bit program counter PC (0x200-0xFFF)
- 8-bit stack pointer SP (0-15)
- 16 16-bit stack values for CALL/RET
- 8-bit delay timer (60Hz countdown)
- 8-bit sound timer (60Hz countdown)
- 4096 bytes RAM (0x000-0xFFF)
- 64x32 pixel framebuffer (1-bit per pixel)
- 16-key keypad state (0-15 mapped to keys)

### Components
- **cpu** (complex, ~350 LOC)
  - fetch(): Uint16 - read 2 bytes from PC via memory.read(), increment PC
  - execute(opcode: Uint16): void - decode and execute all 35 opcodes
  - step(): void - fetch and execute one instruction
  - getRegister(index: Uint8): Uint8 - return V[index]
  - setRegister(index: Uint8, value: Uint8): void - set V[index] = value & 0xFF
  - getI(): Uint16 - return index register
  - setI(value: Uint16): void - set I = value & 0xFFF
  - getPC(): Uint16 - return program counter
  - setPC(value: Uint16): void - set PC = value & 0xFFF
  - getSP(): Uint8 - return stack pointer
  - REQ: Implement all 35 CHIP-8 opcodes with accurate behavior
  - REQ: Handle 16-bit big-endian instruction fetch
  - REQ: Manage program counter, index register, and stack
  - REQ: Update timers and handle sound generation
  - REQ: Process input waits and sprite drawing
- **memory** (simple, ~80 LOC)
  - read(address: Uint16): Uint8 - return ram[address & 0xFFF]
  - write(address: Uint16, value: Uint8): void - ram[address & 0xFFF] = value
  - loadROM(data: Uint8Array): void - copy to 0x200, validate size ≤ 3584
  - loadFont(): void - copy 80-byte font to 0x000-0x04F
  - reset(): void - clear RAM and reload font
  - REQ: Provide 4096 bytes of RAM
  - REQ: Load ROM files up to 3584 bytes at 0x200
  - REQ: Store font sprites at 0x000-0x050
  - REQ: Validate memory access ranges
- **display** (medium, ~120 LOC)
  - drawSprite(x: Uint8, y: Uint8, bytes: Uint8Array, n: Uint8): Uint8 - XOR draw n bytes at (x,y), return collision (0/1)
  - clear(): void - set all pixels to 0
  - getPixel(x: Uint8, y: Uint8): Uint8 - return pixel at (x&63, y&31)
  - setPixel(x: Uint8, y: Uint8, value: Uint8): void - set pixel to value&1
  - render(): ImageData - return ImageData for canvas
  - getWidth(): Uint8 - return 64
  - getHeight(): Uint8 - return 32
  - REQ: Implement 64x32 monochrome display
  - REQ: Draw sprites using XOR with collision detection
  - REQ: Handle sprite wrapping at edges
  - REQ: Provide clear screen functionality
- **input** (simple, ~60 LOC)
  - isPressed(key: Uint8): boolean - return state of key (0-15)
  - waitKey(): Promise<Uint8> - resolve when any key pressed, return key
  - keyDown(key: Uint8): void - mark key as pressed
  - keyUp(key: Uint8): void - mark key as released
  - reset(): void - release all keys
  - REQ: Track state of 16 hexadecimal keys 0-F
  - REQ: Provide blocking wait for key press
  - REQ: Map to keyboard keys (typically 1-4,Q-R,A-F,Z-V)
- **timers** (simple, ~50 LOC)
  - update(deltaTime: number): void - decrement timers at 60Hz rate
  - getSpeed(): number - return 60 (Hz)
  - isSounding(): boolean - return soundTimer > 0
  - REQ: Implement 60Hz countdown timers
  - REQ: Trigger sound when sound timer > 0
  - REQ: Provide accurate delta time updates
- **sound** (simple, ~40 LOC)
  - start(): void - start buzzer sound
  - stop(): void - stop buzzer sound
  - setFrequency(hz: number): void - set tone frequency
  - REQ: Generate square wave buzzer sound
  - REQ: Start/stop based on sound timer
  - REQ: Use Web Audio API or similar
- **emulator** (medium, ~150 LOC)
  - loadROM(data: Uint8Array): void - load ROM into memory and reset
  - run(): void - start emulation loop
  - pause(): void - pause emulation
  - reset(): void - reset all components to initial state
  - isRunning(): boolean - return running state
  - getFPS(): number - return current frames per second
  - REQ: Coordinate all components
  - REQ: Provide run/pause/reset controls
  - REQ: Handle ROM loading and execution
  - REQ: Manage main emulation loop

### Integration Rules (CRITICAL)
- CPU reads memory via memory.read(address), never direct access
- CPU draws via display.drawSprite(x,y,bytes,n), never framebuffer
- CPU reads input via input.isPressed(key), never key state array
- Memory loads ROM via memory.loadROM(bytes), validates size
- Display renders via display.render(), never direct pixel access
- Timers update via timers.update(deltaTime), never direct decrement
- cpu MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- timers MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- emulator MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- Each component owns its own state. Other components access it ONLY through the public interface — never copy internal data.
- Use camelCase for all method names. No snake_case.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Can load and execute IBM logo ROM showing correct pattern
- Can run CHIP-8 games like Pong, Space Invaders, Tetris
- All 35 opcodes pass test suite with correct flags/timers
- Sound buzzer activates when sound timer > 0
- Sprites wrap correctly at screen edges
- Collision detection sets VF=1 when pixels erased
- Timers decrement at exactly 60Hz
